import json, struct, subprocess, sys, zlib
sys.path.insert(0,'project')
from wire import packet, payload, seal

K,D,N,start=4,2,4,0
def mk(rank=0, psn=0, body=None, ack=False, outgoing=False):
    return packet(rank, psn, body if body is not None else payload(0,0,0,D), ack=ack, outgoing=outgoing)

cases=[]
def bad(f, rank=0, note=''):
    cases.append((note, {'op':'wire','rank':rank,'hex':f.hex()}))

base=mk()
# 1. clean frame -> endpoint valid data
good=('good', {'op':'wire','rank':0,'hex':base.hex()})
# 2. wrong ethertype
f=bytearray(base); f[12:14]=b'\x08\x06'; bad(f,0,'ethertype')
# 3. ihl 0x46 (options) -> wire invalid
f=bytearray(base); f[14]=0x46; bad(f,0,'ihl options')
# 4. ip total length mismatch (extra bytes appended)
f=bytearray(base)+b'\x00\x00'; bad(f,0,'trailing bytes')
# 5. ip total length too small
f=bytearray(base); f[16:18]=struct.pack('!H',40); bad(f,0,'ip len short')
# 6. protocol != 17
f=bytearray(base); f[23]=6; f[24:26]=b'\x00\x00'; f=bytearray(seal(bytes(f)+b'\0'*4)[:len(base)]); bad(mk(),0,'skip')
# simpler: craft with wrong protocol and fix checksum+icrc
def mutate(f, edit):
    g=bytearray(f); edit(g); return bytes(g)
def reseal(g):
    # recompute ipv4 checksum and icrc assuming g is a full frame with 4 trailing icrc bytes
    g=bytearray(g)
    g[24:26]=b'\x00\x00'
    tot=sum(struct.unpack('!10H',bytes(g[14:34])))
    while tot>>16: tot=(tot&65535)+(tot>>16)
    g[24:26]=struct.pack('!H',(~tot)&65535)
    return seal(bytes(g[:-4])+b'\0'*4)
def m(name, f): bad(f,0,name)
m('proto6', reseal(mutate(base,lambda g: g.__setitem__(23,6))))
m('tos/ttl only', mutate(base,lambda g:(g.__setitem__(15,0x2e),g.__setitem__(22,99))))  # tos/ttl not covered by anything? checksum covers them -> invalid
# flags 0x2000 (MF)
m('flags MF', reseal(mutate(base,lambda g: g[20:22].__setitem__(slice(None),b'\x20\x00'))))
m('flags 0x0000', reseal(mutate(base,lambda g: g.__setslice__(0,0,[])) if False else mutate(base,lambda g: g.__setitem__(slice(20,22),b'\x00\x00'))))

# ports
m('ports', reseal(mutate(base,lambda g: g.__setitem__(slice(34,36),b'\x12\xb6'))))

m('udpcksum', reseal(mutate(base,lambda g: g.__setitem__(slice(40,42),b'\x00\x01'))))
# opcode unknown

# bth pad byte
m('pad', reseal(mutate(base,lambda g: g.__setitem__(43,0x02))))
# pkey
m('pkey', reseal(mutate(base,lambda g: g.__setitem__(slice(44,46),b'\x00\x00'))))
# qpn top byte
m('qpn top', reseal(mutate(base,lambda g: g.__setitem__(46,0x01))))
# apsn top byte wrong for DATA
m('apsn top', reseal(mutate(base,lambda g: g.__setitem__(50,0x00))))
# payload length wrong
f=bytearray(base); f[16:18]=struct.pack('!H',52-4); f[38:40]=struct.pack('!H',32-4); bad(reseal(bytes(f)),'payload len')
# icrc corrupted

# valid ack
